questions.question: What is the name of the portal launched by the Reserve Bank of India in May 2025 for the regulated entities (REs) to report details of their digital lending apps (DLAs)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Centralised Information Management System (CIMS)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** launched a dedicated portal on its **Centralised Information Management System (CIMS)** in **May 2025** to maintain a repository of **Digital Lending Apps (DLAs)**.
 
• This initiative requires all **Regulated Entities (REs)**, such as **Banks** and **Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs)**, to report and regularly update information regarding the **DLAs** they use or outsource for lending activities.
 
• The primary objective of this portal is to provide a **verified list** of authorized apps to the public, thereby protecting consumers from **unauthorized** or **illegal lending apps** that often engage in predatory practices.
 
• The **CIMS** repository includes critical data points such as the **name of the app**, the **name of the RE** it is associated with, the **web link** of the app, and the **official logo**.
 
• By mandating this reporting, the **RBI** aims to enhance **transparency** and **accountability** within the rapidly growing **Fintech** ecosystem in **India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Centralised Information Management System (CIMS):**
 
 
• **CIMS** is the **RBI's** next-generation **data warehouse**, which was initially launched to replace the older **XBRL (eXtensible Business Reporting Language)** based reporting system.
 
• It utilizes advanced **Big Data** analytics and **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** to manage the vast amounts of financial data generated by the **Indian banking sector**.
 
• The system serves as a **single source of truth** for regulatory reporting, **monetary policy** analysis, and **financial stability** monitoring.
 
 
 
• **Digital Lending Landscape in India:**
 
 
• **Digital Lending** refers to the process of offering loans through web platforms or mobile apps, often using **automated technologies** for credit assessment.
 
• The **RBI** issued comprehensive **Digital Lending Guidelines** in **September 2022** to regulate the flow of credit and ensure **Consumer Protection**.
 
• In **2024-2025**, the surge in **unauthorized apps** led the government and **RBI** to tighten the **Whitelisting** process for apps allowed on the **Google Play Store** and **Apple App Store**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Regulatory Compliance:** Any **DLA** that is not listed on the **CIMS** repository by its respective **Regulated Entity** can be flagged as **unauthorized** by law enforcement agencies.
 
• **Data Security:** **REs** are responsible for ensuring that their **DLAs** comply with **data localization** norms and the **Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023**.
 
• **Consumer Redressal:** The portal complements the **RBI's Ombudsman Scheme** and the **Sachet Portal**, which is used for reporting **illegal financial activities**.
 
• **Transparency:** The public can access the repository to verify if a lending app is genuinely partnered with a **licensed bank** or **NBFC** before sharing personal documents.
</ul

questions.question: How many seats did the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) win in the 2025 Bihar Assembly election?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**89**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2025 Bihar Legislative Assembly election** was conducted to elect representatives for the **243 constituencies** of the state assembly.
 
• The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** secured a total of **89 seats**, emerging as a primary pillar of the **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)** in the state.
 
• The election results were officially declared in **November 2025**, following a multi-phase voting process that spanned across the **38 districts** of **Bihar**.
 
• The **89 seats** won by the **BJP** represented a significant portion of the **122 seats** required to reach the **majority mark** in the **Bihar Vidhan Sabha**.
 
• This election saw the **BJP** consolidate its presence in key regions such as **North Bihar** and the **Magadh** division, contributing to the overall stability of the coalition government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bihar Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha):**
 
 
• The **Bihar Legislative Assembly** consists of **243 elected members**, each serving a term of **5 years**.
 
• It is the lower house of the **Bicameral Legislature** of **Bihar**, with the **Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad)** being the upper house.
 
• The **2025** election was the **18th** assembly election held in the state since **Independence**.
 
 
 
• **Alliance Dynamics:**
 
 
• The **BJP** contested the **2025** elections in alliance with the **Janata Dal (United)**, led by **Nitish Kumar**, under the banner of the **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)**.
 
• The primary opposition was the **Mahagathbandhan** (Grand Alliance), which included the **Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD)** and the **Indian National Congress**.
 
• Key state leaders for the **BJP** during this period included **Samrat Choudhary** and **Vijay Kumar Sinha**.
 
 
 
• **Comparison and Trends:**
 
 
• In the previous **2020 Bihar Assembly elections**, the **BJP** had won **74 seats**; thus, the **89 seats** in **2025** indicate an upward trajectory in their electoral performance.
 
• The election was managed by the **Election Commission of India (ECI)**, utilizing **Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail (VVPAT)** and **Electronic Voting Machines (EVM)** across all booths.
 
• Major campaign themes included **economic development**, **social justice**, and **infrastructure projects** under the **Double Engine Government** narrative.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Constitutional Framework:** The conduct of state elections is governed by **Article 324** of the **Constitution of India**, which grants the **Election Commission** the power of superintendence, direction, and control.
 
• **Seat Distribution:** Out of the **243 seats** in **Bihar**, **38 seats** are reserved for **Scheduled Castes (SC)** and **2 seats** are reserved for **Scheduled Tribes (ST)**.
 
• **Geopolitical Impact:** The **BJP's** performance in **Bihar** is often seen as a bellwether for political trends in the **Hindi Heartland** and has significant implications for the **Rajya Sabha** seat distribution.
</ul

questions.question: Where was the 2025 World Para Athletics Grand Prix held?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2025 World Para Athletics Grand Prix** is scheduled to be held in **New Delhi**, **India**.
 
• The event is a major part of the international calendar for para-athletics, bringing together elite athletes from across the globe to compete in various track and field disciplines.
 
• The **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium** in **New Delhi** serves as the primary venue for this prestigious competition, offering world-class facilities for para-athletes.
 
• The tournament is organized under the aegis of **World Para Athletics**, the international governing body for the sport, in collaboration with the **Paralympic Committee of India (PCI)**.
 
• Hosting the Grand Prix in **India** highlights the country's rising stature in the **Paralympic movement** and its commitment to promoting sports for persons with disabilities.
 
• Athletes participating in this Grand Prix aim to achieve **Minimum Entry Standards (MES)** and improve their **World Rankings** for upcoming major championships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **World Para Athletics Grand Prix Series:** 
 
 
• This is a series of international events launched by **World Para Athletics** to provide a high-level competition circuit for athletes with physical, intellectual, or vision impairments.
 
• The series includes multiple stops worldwide, including cities like **Dubai**, **Tunis**, and **Jesolo**, before concluding with the final rankings.
 
 
 
• **Paralympic Committee of India (PCI):**
 
 
• Founded in **1992**, the **PCI** is the national body responsible for the development and promotion of para-sports in **India**.
 
• It is recognized by the **International Paralympic Committee (IPC)** and the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, **Government of India**.
 
• The committee has been instrumental in **India**'s record-breaking performance at the **Paris 2024 Paralympics**, where the country secured **29 medals**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of New Delhi as a Sports Hub:**
 
 
• **New Delhi** has a long history of hosting mega-sporting events, including the **1951** and **1982 Asian Games** and the **2010 Commonwealth Games**.
 
• The **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium** has a seating capacity of approximately **60,000** and features a synthetic track suitable for international athletics.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Indian Para-Athletics:**
 
 
• By hosting international meets like the **Grand Prix**, local athletes get the opportunity to compete against the best in the world on home soil, reducing travel burdens and increasing exposure.
 
• Such events also help in scouting new talent and sensitizing the general public towards **Para-sports** and inclusivity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Classification System:** In **World Para Athletics**, athletes are grouped into classes (denoted by 'T' for track and 'F' for field followed by a **number**) based on the impact of their impairment on performance to ensure fair competition.
 
• **Qualification Standards:** The results from the **2025 Grand Prix** in **New Delhi** are official and are used to determine eligibility for the **World Para Athletics Championships**.
 
• **Growth in Participation:** Over the last decade, the number of participating nations and athletes in the **Grand Prix** circuit has seen a steady increase, reflecting the global growth of **Para-sports**.
</ul

questions.question: The Supreme Court extended the stay on tree cutting in how many acres of land at Kancha Gachibowli in Hyderabad in April 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**400 acres**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Supreme Court of India**, in **April 2025**, issued an extension on the stay order regarding the cutting of trees in the **Kancha Gachibowli** region of **Hyderabad**.
 
• The specific area protected under this judicial intervention covers **400 acres** of land, which is considered a vital ecological zone in the city.
 
• The court's decision was prompted by the need to evaluate the environmental impact of proposed developmental projects on this **400-acre** stretch, which houses a significant number of heritage trees and local flora.
 
• This legal stay prevents the **Telangana Government** or any private contractors from proceeding with land clearing activities that could lead to large-scale deforestation in the **IT corridor**.
 
• Environmental activists had filed petitions highlighting that the destruction of this greenery would violate existing **environmental norms** and exacerbate the urban heat island effect in **Hyderabad**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kancha Gachibowli:** This area is located in the **Serilingampally mandal** of **Hyderabad**. It has been a subject of long-standing litigation involving land ownership disputes and **environmental conservation** efforts.
 
• **Biodiversity Value:** The **400 acres** in question serve as a "green lung" for the rapidly urbanizing parts of western **Hyderabad**, providing a habitat for various species of birds and small fauna.
 
• **Legal Context:** The **Supreme Court** often intervenes in such matters under the **Public Trust Doctrine**, which mandates that the state must protect natural resources for the enjoyment of the general public rather than permitting their conversion into private ownership or commercial use.
 
• **Urban Development vs. Nature:** The conflict in **Gachibowli** reflects a broader national challenge in **India** where infrastructure expansion frequently clashes with the preservation of **urban forests** and catchment areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Article 21:** The **Judiciary** frequently links the protection of the environment to **Article 21** of the **Constitution of India**, which guarantees the **Right to Life**, including the right to a healthy environment.
 
• **Forest (Conservation) Act:** Any diversion of land that qualifies as a forest or contains a high density of trees typically requires clearance under the **Forest (Conservation) Act, 1980**.
 
• **Historical Precedents:** This case draws parallels to other major environmental litigations in **India**, such as the **Aarey Forest** case in **Mumbai**, where the **Supreme Court** had to balance transit infrastructure needs with **forest preservation**.
 
• **Impact of April 2025 Ruling:** The extension of the stay on these **400 acres** ensures that no irreversible environmental damage occurs while the court examines the **Detailed Project Reports (DPR)** and environmental clearance certificates.
</ul

questions.question: Which of the following missions marked the 100th launch of ISRO from India’s Spaceport Sriharikota, boosting India’s standing in space launch capability?

options.text: Launch of NVS‑02 navigation satellite on GSLV-F15

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Launch of NVS-02 navigation satellite on GSLV-F15**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Launch of NVS-02 navigation satellite on GSLV-F15** is recognized in this context as the milestone marking the **100th launch** from **India’s Spaceport** located at **Sriharikota**. ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***
 
• This mission utilized the **Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV-F15)**, which is a three-stage launch vehicle designed to place satellites into **Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit (GTO)**.
 
• The **NVS-02** is a part of the second-generation satellite series for the **Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC)**, aimed at providing accurate and real-time positioning and timing services over **India** and the surrounding region.
 
• The **Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC) SHAR** in **Sriharikota** has been the primary orbital launch site for **ISRO** since its first launch in **1979** (the **SLV-3**).
 
• Reaching the **100th launch** milestone at a single spaceport signifies **India's** growing self-reliance and commercial viability in the global space market.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Launch of Aditya-L1 solar observatory:**
 
 
• This was **India's** first dedicated solar mission, launched on **September 2, 2023**.
 
• It was launched using the **PSLV-C57** rocket and placed at the **Lagrangian Point 1 (L1)** to study the **Sun's** corona and solar winds. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **Launch of INSAT-3DS weather satellite:**
 
 
• Launched on **February 17, 2024**, via the **GSLV-F14** mission.
 
• It is an advanced meteorological satellite designed for enhanced monitoring of **Earth's** surface, oceanic observations, and weather forecasting. ***Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **Launch of Chandrayaan-3:**
 
 
• Launched on **July 14, 2023**, using the **LVM3-M4** (Launch Vehicle Mark-III) rocket.
 
• This mission successfully performed a soft landing on the **Lunar South Pole** on **August 23, 2023**, making **India** the first country to do so. ***Hence, statement 4 is incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC) SHAR:**
 
 
• Located in **Sriharikota**, **Andhra Pradesh**, it features two active launch pads.
 
• It was named after **Prof. Satish Dhawan**, the former Chairman of **ISRO**, in **2002**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **NavIC (Navigation with Indian Constellation):** Formerly known as **IRNSS**, it consists of a constellation of **7 to 9 satellites** providing **Standard Positioning Service (SPS)** for civilians and **Restricted Service (RS)** for strategic users.
 
• **ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation):** Formed on **August 15, 1969**, with its headquarters in **Bengaluru**. It operates under the **Department of Space**.
 
• **Launch Vehicles:** **ISRO** utilizes various vehicles including **PSLV** (the "workhorse"), **GSLV** (for heavier payloads), **LVM3** (the heaviest launcher), and the **SSLV** (Small Satellite Launch Vehicle).
 
• The **NVS** series satellites incorporate **L1, L5, and S-band** signals and, for the first time, carry an indigenous **Rubidium atomic clock** for high-precision timing.

questions.question: Dr. Duvvur Nageshwar Reddy received the Padma Vibhushan in 2025 for his contributions in which field?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Medicine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Duvvur Nageshwar Reddy** was conferred with the **Padma Vibhushan** in the year **2025** for his exceptional and distinguished service in the field of **Medicine**.
 
• He is a world-renowned **gastroenterologist** and serves as the **Chairman and Founder** of the **Asian Institute of Gastroenterology (AIG)** located in **Hyderabad**, **Telangana**.
 
• His pioneering work is primarily in the field of **Therapeutic Endoscopy**, where he has introduced innovative techniques that have revolutionized gastrointestinal treatments globally.
 
• The **Padma Vibhushan** is the **second-highest civilian award** in **India**, preceded by the Bharat Ratna and followed by the Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri.
 
• Dr. Reddy is recognized as one of the world's leading experts in **Gastrointestinal Endoscopy** and has trained thousands of doctors from across the globe at his institute.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

__
 
• **Origin of International Day of Yoga:**
 
 
• The idea for an **International Day of Yoga** was first proposed by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** during his address to the **United Nations General Assembly (UNGA)** on **September 27, 2014**.
 
• The **UNGA** draft resolution was passed with a record **175 member states** co-sponsoring the initiative, leading to the official declaration of **June 21** as the **International Day of Yoga**.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Ayush:**
 
 
• This **Union Ministry** is the nodal agency for the celebration of **Yoga Day** in **India**.
 
• It promotes **Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy**. The ministry issues the **Common Yoga Protocol (CYP)**, which serves as a guide for yoga performances globally.

• The date **June 21** was chosen because it is the **Summer Solstice**, the **longest day of the year** in the **Northern Hemisphere**.
 
• In **Indian mythology**, the **Summer Solstice** marks the transition to **Dakshinayana** and is considered the period when **Lord Shiva** (the **Adiyogi**) began imparting the knowledge of yoga to the **Saptarishis**.
 
 
 
• **Previous Host Cities:**
 
 
• The first-ever **Yoga Day** in **2015** was held at **Rajpath, New Delhi**, creating two **Guinness World Records**.
 
• In subsequent years, the national event moved to cities like **Chandigarh (2016)**, **Lucknow (2017)**, **Dehradun (2018)**, **Ranchi (2019)**, **Mysuru (2022)**, **Jabalpur (2023)**, and **Srinagar (2024)**.
 
 
 
• **Yoga for Health:**
 
 
• Scientific studies promoted during these events highlight that **Yoga** helps in reducing **stress**, improving **cardiovascular health**, and enhancing **mental clarity**.
 
• The **World Health Organization (WHO)** also mentions **Yoga** as a tool to improve physical activity in its **Global Action Plan 2018-2030**.

questions.question: What is the name of the pilot initiative launched by the Government of India in Sonbhadra, Uttar Pradesh on 24 June 2025, which is focused on vocational training for adolescent girls?

• **NAVYA** is a unique **pilot initiative** launched by the **Government of India** on **24 June 2025**.
 
• The program was specifically inaugurated in **Sonbhadra district** of **Uttar Pradesh**, which is identified as one of the **Aspirational Districts** under the central government's development framework.
 
• The primary focus of the **NAVYA** scheme is to provide **vocational training** and **skill development** to **adolescent girls**, particularly those belonging to **marginalized** and **tribal communities**.
 
• The initiative aims to bridge the **gender gap** in technical education by offering courses in **digital literacy**, **financial management**, and **healthcare assistance**. ***Hence, the correct answer is NAVYA.***
 
• It is designed to empower girls between the **age group of 14 to 18 years** who may have dropped out of formal schooling or require additional job-oriented skills to improve their **employability**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Geographic Significance of Sonbhadra:**
 
 
• **Sonbhadra** is the only district in **India** that shares its boundary with four states: **Madhya Pradesh**, **Chhattisgarh**, **Jharkhand**, and **Bihar**.
 
• Choosing this location for the **NAVYA** pilot ensures that the benefits reach a high concentration of **Scheduled Tribes (ST)** and **Scheduled Castes (SC)** populations.
 
 
 
• **The Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP):**
 
 
• Launched by the **NITI Aayog** in **January 2018**, the program aims to quickly and effectively transform **112** of the most under-developed districts across the country.
 
• Initiatives like **NAVYA** are part of the broader strategy to improve indicators in **Health & Nutrition**, **Education**, and **Skill Development** within these regions.

• **AMRUTA:** While similar to **AMRUT** (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation), it does not specifically target adolescent vocational training in the context of the **June 2025** Sonbhadra launch.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Digital Integration:** A key feature of **NAVYA** is the **"Digital Sakhi"** component, where trained girls act as catalysts for **digital payments** and online services in their respective villages.
